values.description: Base URL of the Lando environment. No trailing slash.
UUID of an open voting question. Copy from /admin/content/voting-questions.
UUID of an option that belongs to question_uuid.
UUID of an option that belongs to a DIFFERENT question than question_uuid. Used only for the 422 error case.
Base64 of username:password for a Drupal user with the 'vote' permission. Run: echo -n 'user:pass' | base64
Base64 of username:password for a Drupal user with the 'administer voting' permission. Run: echo -n 'admin:pass' | base64
